Burning Chop Lv. 1 Fire attacks enemies in front with 167 Power added to P. Atk., causes burns, and makes them consume 43 HP every second. Cannot be used when a bow/crossbow is equipped. Over-hit. Critical.
Onslaught of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage around enemy. Power: 1895. Applies to enemy: Burns 50 HP every second. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Seal of Flame Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage on nearby enemies. Power: 30. Applies to enemy: Burns 60 HP every sec. Over-hit is possible.
Seal of Gloom Lv. 1 Burns MP of nearby enemies. Power: 29. Applies to enemy: Burns 12 MP every sec.
Seal of Mirage Lv. 1 Throws nearby enemies into chaos, causing them to attack anybody randomly.
Chant of Life Lv. 1 Recovers all party members HP by 5%. Recovers 12 HP per second for all party members.
Steal Essence Lv. 1 Inflicts non-Attribute damage on an enemy with 52 Power added to M. Atk. Absorbs 80% of the damage as HP.
Heart of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Restores a clan member's HP with 91 Power and recovers 31 HP per second.
Honor of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Restores 500 CP to nearby party/alliance members.
Ritual of Life Lv. 1 Restores 750 CP. Can be applied only to your character or party member.

Curse of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 A curse that deals damage with power starting from 60 and has a chance to trigger a random debuff on each affected target from those available to the character. The assortment of debuffs depends on the level of the skill Curse of Pa'agrio, and the levels of the debuffs depend on their levels in the character.

Ritual of Preserve Lv. 1 Absorbs 1200 damage. All Skills Hit Time -15% Resistance to Mana Burn +50%. Can be applied only to party member. Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party. Effect only works while in a party with the caster.
Life Impact Lv. 1 Recovers 15% HP instantly to target under 'Chant of Life'. Removes 'Chant of Life'.
Wisdom of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 For party and clan members: Cast. Spd. +25%.
Vision of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 For party and clan members: Accuracy +2.

Protection Shield of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 For party members: P. Def. +5% Received P. Crit. Damage -5%. Effect only works while in a party with the caster. Only one of these effects can be active at a time: 'Counter Critical', 'Chant of Protection Spirit', 'Protection Shield of Pa'agrio', any 'Greater Shield', or 'Earth Chant'/'Earth Motive'.
Rage of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Decreases nearby clan members' P. Def. by 6%, M. Def. by 12%, and Evasion by 2, and increases P. Atk. by 6%, M. Atk. by 12%, Atk. Spd. by 6%, Cast. Spd. by 6%, and Speed by 6.

Victory of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 For Party and Alliance Members: Max CP +20% Max MP +20% CP Regeneration +20% P. Skills Power +5% P. Atk. +5% P. Def. +10% Atk. Spd. +8% P. Crit. Rate +15% M. Atk. +10% M. Def. +10% Cast. Spd. +8% M. Crit. Damage +10% Resistance to debuffs +10% Speed -10%.
Emblem of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 For clan members: Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +20% Resistance to debuffs +12%.
Fist of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Nearby party members' CP regeneration +50% and Max CP +10%. CP recovery efficiency with 'Honor of Pa'agrio' skill, CP Potions and Elixirs +10%.

Flames of Invincibility Lv. 1 Makes nearby party/alliance members invincible against damage and debuffs. This effect is canceled if any action other than movement is initiated. Can't be applied more than once every 600 seconds.
Enlightenment Lv. 1 M. Atk. +10% Cast. Spd. +30% Incoming Heal Power +40% M. Crit. Rate +50% M. Skills MP Consumption -90%.
Combat of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects. For party and clan members: P. Atk. +11% P. Def. +11%.
Critical of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Combines 'Focus' and 'Death Whisper' effects. For party and clan members: P. Crit. Rate +18% P. Crit. Damage +23%.
Condition of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Combines 'Bless the Body' and 'Bless the Soul' effects. For party and clan members: Max HP +12% Max MP +12%.
Movement of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Combines 'Wind Walk' and 'Agility' effects. For party and clan members: Speed +33 Evasion +3.
Rampage of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Combines 'Haste' and 'Vampiric Rage' effects. For party and clan members: Atk. Spd. +21% Recovers as HP 6% of melee damage dealt.
Magic of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Combines 'Empower' and 'Magic Barrier' effects. For party and clan members: M. Atk. +45% M. Def. +18%.

Legacy of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 For Party Members: Max HP +10% P. Skills Power +3% P. Atk. +3% P. Def. +6% Atk. Spd. +5% P. Crit. Rate +10% M. Atk. +6% M. Def. +6% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Damage +6% Resistance to debuffs +8% Recovers as HP 2% of melee damage dealt Speed -10%.

Hammer Crush Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 487 Power to stun an enemy. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. While the effect is active, Resistance to Stun is significantly increased.
Fear Lv. 1 Frightens an enemy into fleeing.
Seal of Chaos Lv. 1 Decreases Accuracy of nearby enemies by 9.
Dreaming Spirit Lv. 1 Causes an enemy to sleep.
Seal of Slow Lv. 1 Decreases Speed of nearby enemies by 20%.
Seal of Winter Lv. 1 Decreases Atk. Spd. of nearby enemies by 23%.
Madness Lv. 1 Confuses an enemy into attacking random targets.
Seal of Binding Lv. 1 Holds nearby enemies.
Seal of Poison Lv. 1 Poisons nearby enemies, causing loss of 14 HP per second.
Seal of Silence Lv. 1 Blocks nearby enemies' use of magic.
Seal of Scourge Lv. 1 Blocks nearby enemies' natural HP recovery ability by 100%.
Seal of Suspension Lv. 1 Decreases nearby enemies' physical/magic skill re-use time by 200%.
Seal of Despair Lv. 1 For nearby enemies: Accuracy -3 P. Atk. -5% Atk. Spd. -15% Cast. Spd. -10% P. Crit. Rate -15% P. Crit. Damage -15% Speed -10% M. Def. -15%.
Seal of Disease Lv. 1 For nearby enemies: Incoming Heal Power -50%.
Seal of Blockade Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage on nearby enemies. Power: 80. Applies to enemy: Blocks ordinary attacks.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Arcane Power Lv. 1 M. Atk. +30% M. Skills MP Consumption +10%. Consumes 35 HP per second.
Soul Cry Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 and consumes 0 MP per second.
Soul Guard Lv. 1 P. Def. +293.3. Continuously consumes 5 MP.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Turn to Stone Lv. 1 Petrifies oneself for 8 seconds to avoid incurring damage.
Magician's Movement Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Atk. Spd. -20%.
Spellcraft Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Cast. Spd. -50%.
Mana Recovery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: MP Regeneration +20%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 1.5 and M. Atk. by 1.9. Absorb 10% of standard melee damage inflicted on an enemy as MP.
Robe Mastery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: P. Def. +12.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +13 Cast. Spd. +90% Atk. Spd. +25% MP Regeneration +20%.
Heavy Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Heavy Armor: P. Def. +12 Cast. Spd. +71% Atk. Spd. +25%.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Toughness Lv. 1 Resistance to Sleep/Hold/Poison +20%.
Anti Magic Lv. 1 M. Def. +10.
Quick Recycle Lv. 1 Decreases Reuse Delay for magic by 10%.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Boost HP Lv. 1 Increases Max HP by 60.
Fast HP Recovery Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Boost Mana Lv. 1 Increases Max MP by 30.
Fast Spell Casting Lv. 1 Cast. Spd. +5%.
Fast Mana Recovery Lv. 1 Increases MP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Higher Mana Gain Lv. 1 Additionally increases recovery +22 MP when used Recharge skill.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Health Lv. 1 Resistance to Poison +10% Resistance to Bleeding +10%.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Spell Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's INT, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Divine Lore Lv. 1 M. Skills MP Consumption -3%.
PvE Clarity Lv. 1 Single target's M. Skills MP Consumption in PvE only: -30%.

Mystic Fury Lv. 1 When using skills 'Heart of Pa'agrio', 'Honor of Pa'agrio', 'Burning Chop', 'Onslaught of Pa'agrio', 'Seal of Gloom', 'Seal of Blockade', 'Seal of Flame', or 'Curse of Pa'agrio', 15% chance for party members: M. Atk. +8% All Skills MP Consumption -6%. Duration: 10 sec. Reuse time: 15 sec.

Unity of Pa'agrio Lv. 1 Depending on the number of party members in a large radius - decreases your MP Consumption for P. Skills and M. Skills: 2 members: -10% 3 members: -15% 4 members: -20% 5 members: -25% 6 members: -30% 7 members: -35% 8 members: -40% 9 members: -50%
